{{Infobox character|name=Katla|epithet=the lone voice|house=[[House Stormrider]]|role=Elder|age=~50}}
'''Katla''' has warned for decades that [[House Stormrider]]'s story of itself is too clean — that the house was never the Unification's architect, only someone's instrument. No one listens; in the house of unity, the one who stands alone divides. She stands alone anyway.
